newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices mixed, volume remains thin.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices mixed, volume remains thin.

text.p: Trade on the Istanbul gold exchange remained thin with volume rising only slightly to 900 kilos on Tuesday from Monday's 880 kilos, largely on physical demand from the free market, dealers said.
Gold fell in dollar terms to $343.80 an ounce from $345.00 on Monday, but firmed in lira terms to 1,550,000 per gram versus 1,539,000 as the lira weakened against the dollar.
The Turkish currency slipped to 139,640 to the dollar, compared to the previous close of 139,300.
Most of the day's trade -- 890 kilos -- took place in the morning session while 80 percent of trade was conducted in lira terms. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-2750875
